schema.name: Botulinum toxin treatment (Botox, Xeomin)
schema.howPerformed: Small units of botulinum toxin type A are injected into the specific muscles that crease the overlying skin, relaxing them for three to four months.

acceptedAnswer.text: The needle is very fine and each injection takes about a second. Most patients describe a quick sting. No anesthetic is needed, and you can drive yourself home.

mainEntity.name: How soon will I see it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Movement starts to soften after three to seven days, and the full effect shows at about two weeks. We book your follow-up then.
Not if it's dosed and placed well. We treat the muscles that are creasing the skin and leave the rest working, and we keep first treatments conservative.

mainEntity.name: What happens when it wears off?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your muscles gradually go back to how they worked before, and so do the lines. Nothing ends up worse than it was.

mainEntity.name: How many units will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your muscles and the areas you want treated, so we can't say over the phone. You'll get your number and a quote after the assessment, before anything is injected.
